newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syrian daily says Netanyahu caused Tel Aviv bomb.
newsitem.headline: Syrian daily says Netanyahu caused Tel Aviv bomb.

text.p: An official Syrian daily said on Sunday Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's policies caused Friday's attack on a packed Tel Aviv cafe by an Islamic suicide bomber which killed three Israeli women.
The English-language Syria Times said Netanyahu was also responsibe for clashes between Palestinians and Israeli forces in the West Bank.

The newspaper said ..."tragic events in the occupied Arab territories manifested through fierce clashes between angry Palestinian stone-throwers and Israeli army troops ... and the Tel Aviv explosion are the product of Israel's flagrant policy of settlement and arrogant intransigence."
"The hardline Likud government of Netanyahu has not only placed new obstacles in the path of peace ... but is feverishly pushing the region to the brink of explosion," it said.
The Palestinian militant group Hamas claimed responsibility for the Friday bombing and threatened to launch further attacks if Israel went on building a new Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.

Fierce Israeli-Arab clashes flared in the West Bank on Saturday with Israeli forces firing live ammunition at hundreds of Arabs who protested at Netanyahu's decision to build 6,500 housing units for Jews in East Jerusalem.
The official Syrian daily warned that a new war might errupt in the region if Netanyahu did not change his policies.
Syria has held sporadic peace talks with Israel since 1991 but the negotiations were stalled over the fate of the Golan Heights, captured by Israel in 1967.
The talks broke off a year ago and Syria said it would not resume until Netanyahu accepts full pullback from the Golan.
